sentences.text: Shri. Wanbha Bhoi vs . State Of Meghalaya & Anr. on 25 March,

2026 
Author: W. Diengdoh
Bench: W. Diengdoh
 Serial No. 02
 Regular List
 High Court Of Meghalaya
 At Shillong
Crl.A. No. 14 of 2026
 Date of Order: 25.03.2026
Shri. Wanbha Bhoi Vs. State of Meghalaya & Anr.
Coram:
 Hon'ble Mr. Justice W. Diengdoh, Judge
 Hon'ble Mr. Justice B. Bhattacharjee, Judge
Appearance:
For the Petitioner/Appellant(s) : Ms. E.G.S. War, Adv.
 Mr. G.J. Nongrum, Adv.
 Ms. I.K. War, Adv.
 Mr. K.I. Laloo, Adv.
 Mr. R.Oo. Lyngdoh, Adv.
For the Respondent(s) : Mr. R. Gurung, Ga.

This is an appeal against the impugned judgment dated 08.12.2025 and related order of sentence dated 10.12.2025 passed by the Court of the learned Sessions Judge, West Jaintia Hills District,
Jowai in Sessions Case No. 14 of 2020, wherein, he was directed to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10(ten) years with fine of  5000/- (Rupees five thousand) only, and in default thereof, to undergo simple imprisonment for 1(one) month for an offence punishable under Section 376(1) IPC.
Mr. R. Gurung, learned GA has entered appearance on behalf of the State respondent, as such, no formal notice is required to be issued upon the said respondent.
On consideration of the submission made, and on perusal of the memo of appeal, we are inclined to admit this appeal, the same is hereby admitted.

The Trial Court records are hereby called for, on receipt of the same, appellant to prepare the paper book and place it on the records.
Shri. Wanbha Bhoi vs . State Of Meghalaya & Anr.
